name: Carrefour Orhideea

sources.label: OSM w23557062 · Centrul Comercial Orhideea (the building; unchanged source footprint)

improvements: The west wall of Centrul Comercial Orhideea towards Sos. Orhideelor carries a red fascia band and a white panel with blue Carrefour lettering at the roof edge. The building stays its source footprint; only the band and the sign are this landmark.
remainingGaps: Band height (6.6 m), panel size (27 × 4 m) and letter height are estimates from a street-level reference (viewed only); the real sign uses the brand logo, which is not reproduced.
In isolation this model is only a band and a panel, so the published views are in-world captures in Grozavesti. The registry declares no replacement source id.
